This vignette demonstrates how to access and visualize dataset [E-GEOD-81383](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gxa/sc/experiments/E-GEOD-81383) from the Single-Cell Expression Atlas using the `ExpressionAtlas` package.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
```

```{r load-packages}
library( ExpressionAtlas ) 
library( SingleCellExperiment )
library( ggplot2 )
```

```{r single-cell-search,eval=TRUE}

sc_search_results <- searchSCAtlasExperiments( query = "hematopoietic", secondaryFilter = "old" )
print(sc_search_results)
```

```{r single-cell-download, eval=TRUE}

geod81383 <- getAtlasSCExperiment( "E-GEOD-81383" )
geod81383

print("Reduced dimension names:")
print(reducedDimNames(geod81383 ))

print("Column data names:")
print(colnames(colData(geod81383 )))

```

```{r single-cel-plot-cluster, eval=TRUE}
# Colour the same UMAP by Louvain cluster, genotype, age, and cell line.

plotDimRedSCAtlasExperiment(geod81383, dimRed = "X_umap_neighbors_n_neighbors_20", colorby = "louvain_resolution_0.1", save_pdf = FALSE, plot_layers = list(ggplot2::theme_classic()))

plotDimRedSCAtlasExperiment(geod81383, dimRed = "X_umap_neighbors_n_neighbors_20", colorby = "genotype", save_pdf = FALSE, plot_layers = list(ggplot2::theme_classic()))

plotDimRedSCAtlasExperiment(geod81383, dimRed = "X_umap_neighbors_n_neighbors_20", colorby = "age", save_pdf = FALSE, plot_layers = list(ggplot2::theme_classic(), ggplot2::scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2")))

plotDimRedSCAtlasExperiment(geod81383, dimRed = "X_umap_neighbors_n_neighbors_20", colorby = "cell_line", save_pdf = FALSE, plot_layers = list(ggplot2::theme_classic() , ggplot2::scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Accent")))
```

```{r single-cell-heatmap-plot, eval=TRUE}

# Plot marker genes for K = 3 using unscaled normalized expression.
heatmapSCAtlasExperiment(geod81383, genes=NULL, sel.K=3, scaleNormExp=FALSE, show_row_names=FALSE, save_pdf = FALSE ) 


# Plot the same marker genes after scaling expression for each gene.
heatmapSCAtlasExperiment(geod81383, genes=NULL, sel.K=3, scaleNormExp=TRUE, show_row_names=FALSE, save_pdf = FALSE) 

# Plot unscaled expression and display Gene names. 
dotPlotSCAtlasExperiment(geod81383, genes=c('ENSG00000185664', 'ENSG00000205777', 'CD36'), sel.K=3, scaleNormExp=TRUE, geneLabel = 'name', save_pdf = FALSE, dot_theme = list(ggplot2::theme_classic()))

# Plot scaled expression and display Gene IDs. 
dotPlotSCAtlasExperiment(geod81383, genes=c('ENSG00000185664','ENSG00000205777', 'CD36'), sel.K=3, scaleNormExp=TRUE, geneLabel = 'id', save_pdf = FALSE, dot_theme = list(ggplot2::theme_classic()))

```
